subject: Next steps: Trial integration readiness & dev plan
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@finztech.com>, Carlos Mendes <carlos@finztech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, Apr 01 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + asks from today's discovery — trial goals and integration plan

Thanks again for the demo and the productive conversation today. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can lock the trial start and scope: 

Summary of what we heard
- Goal: evaluate Redwood inference for low-latency recommendation reranking and conversational support in FinzTech product flows.
- Primary success metrics: 95th pct latency < 350ms (95% of requests), average inference cost <$0.003 per 1k tokens, and a measurable uplift in click-through for recommended items (expected +6-10%).

Proposed trial scope (please confirm):
1) 4-week trial window with a staging integration that mirrors prod traffic for a sample set (~10k daily requests).
2) Use Redwood hosted environment initially; optionally evaluate Dedicated later.
3) Technical deliverables: SDK integration for streaming responses, a sample rerank API route, and tool-calling for downstream enrichment.

Concrete asks / next steps for you before kickoff:
- Confirm trial window and go/no-go date (we tentatively proposed Apr 11 start).
- Confirm FinzTech engineering lead for the integration (we understood Carlos will own eng side). If not Carlos, please provide the contact.
- Share a small redacted test dataset (100 example queries + reference labels) so our SEs can pre-run baseline benchmarks.
- Complete the attached trial-mvp-checklist.xlsx and return by EOD Tue Apr 6.

Technical notes we will prepare (attached): redwood-integration-snippets.md with example SDK code (Python/Node), recommended endpoints, and streaming examples using our SDK. Expect sample auth instructions (API key + optional mTLS).

I'll follow up with a brief integration playbook and a calendar invite for kickoff once you confirm owners and the start date.

Best,
Hannah
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: trial-mvp-checklist.xlsx, redwood-integration-snippets.md

Thanks Hannah — appreciated. Confirming a few items from FinzTech side:

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <carlos@finztech.com>, Priya Shah <priya@finztech.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, Apr 05 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Integration notes — endpoints, streaming, and quick test plan

Carlos / Priya — quick technical follow-up ahead of the Apr 12 kickoff. Below are recommended approaches so your engineers know what to expect.

1) Authentication & access
- We will issue a scoped trial API key with request-level quotas. Optionally we can enable mTLS for extra security during the trial.

2) SDKs & routes (we will share code in redwood-integration-snippets.md)
- Rerank route (non-streaming): POST /v1/rerank with body {model: "rw-rerank-v1", items: [...], context: "..."} — responds with ranked indices and confidence scores.
- Chat/assist (streaming): POST /v1/streams/chat with stream=true — supports incremental tokens and partial replies for UI streaming.
- Tool calling: /v1/tools/invoke — use for enrichment calls (e.g., external price lookup) in a validated sandbox.

3) Recommended model and quantization
- For latency-sensitive rerank use rw-rerank-v1 or a distilled open variant. We will config a quantization profile for the trial to hit latency targets; we'll propose profiles in our pre-run.

4) Telemetry and observability
- We will provide a trial dashboard with per-route latency histograms, token-level cost, and error traces. Send sample traffic pattern (qps, median length) so we can pre-tune batching.

5) Minimal test plan for week 0 (before Apr 12)
- Provide 100 labeled examples (Carlos) + expected ranking.
- We will run a baseline run in our staging account and return initial latency/cost numbers within 48 hours.

6) Attachments and sample snippets: redwood-integration-snippets.md includes Node/Python streaming examples, sample request/response body shapes, and retry/backoff recommendations.

If you have any constraints on payload size or tokenization we should know in advance, flag them now.

Thanks — Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — wrapping up the thread with confirmed commitments so nothing slips.

- Trial window: Apr 12 — May 9 (4 weeks).
- FinzTech owners: Carlos Mendes (engineering lead), Priya Shah (product lead), Lina Gomez (data/compliance).
- Redwood owners: Karthik Iyer (SE, integration), Dylan Brooks (AE, commercial), Hannah Schmitt (trial ops).

Pre-kickoff items (due Apr 5):

- Priya: return filled checklist and baseline CTR numbers (ACTION: Priya)

Kickoff: calendar invite sent for Apr 12 10:00 AM PT — agenda attached in the invite (tech plan, security checklist review, success metrics, timelines). Dial-in + Google Meet link in invite.

Where we will focus during trial weeks:

- Week 2: streaming integration and tool-calling flows for enrichment.
- Week 3: performance tuning (batching/quantization), optional Dedicated discussion.
- Week 4: evaluation, metrics capture, and decision review.

Shared links: https://drive.google.com/finztech/trial-plan (live playbook), HubSpot-Contact-12345, DocuSign-Envelope-0a1b2c.

If anything changes, flag here and we'll update the kickoff agenda. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
